Featured images gallery

Build email marketing, SMS, and WhatsApp campaigns powered by AI to grow ecommerce sales.

Go beyond the basics with the Klaviyo marketing app. New stores get a guided setup — sign-up form, welcome email, and abandoned-checkout flow — without leaving Shopify Admin. Unify data from 350+ integrations and boost marketing performance with campaigns, smart segmentation, and automated workflows from Klaviyo’s AI Agents. Over 117k brands use Klaviyo and Shopify to grow faster with personalized emails, SMS, WhatsApp messages, and marketing automation tools that turn browsers into buyers.

Feedback submitted

Merchants call this a game changer for email and SMS marketing that directly drives revenue through automated flows like welcome, abandoned cart, post‑purchase, and win‑back. They highlight powerful segmentation, reliable Shopify syncing, and detailed revenue attribution. Many find it intuitive to design on‑brand emails, popups, and SMS, appreciate stable performance, rich analytics, responsive support, and AI tools that speed up campaign creation and strategy.

I just wish billing and pricing is easier to understand.

Data access

This app needs access to the following data to work on your store. Learn why in the developer's privacy policy .

View customer data:

Sensitive data, device and activity data

  • Sensitive data

    Name, email address, phone number, physical address

  • Device and activity data

    Geolocation, IP address, browser and operating system, browsing behavior, client ID cookie

View staff and contributor data:

Store owner, blog contributors

  • Store owner

    Name, email address, phone number, physical address

  • Blog contributors

    Email address, IP address, browser and operating system

View and edit store data:

Customers, products, orders, discounts, gift cards, store credit, store analytics, Online Store, Shopify admin, other data

  • Edit customers

    Browsing behavior, customer data

  • Edit products

    Inventory, product listings, products, collections

  • Edit orders

    All order history, order edits

  • Edit discounts

    Discount codes and promotions

  • View gift cards

    Gift card transactions, gift cards

  • View store credit

    Store credit account transactions, store credit accounts

  • Edit store analytics

    Reports, web pixels, server pixels

  • Edit Online Store

    Online Store pages, Online Store script tags, theme, Online Store page content on a path controlled by the app

  • View Shopify admin

    Files

  • Edit other data

    Locales, locations, Shopify Markets settings, price rules, publications of products on sales channels
